title: feat(toggleRefinement): support new routing system
body:
This updates `toggleRefinement` lifecycle methods to support the new routing system.

## `getWidgetState` changes

This method ignores previous UI state values. Otherwise, new values gets skipped.

## `getWidgetSearchParameters` changes

This method is self-contained. It sets both `disjunctiveFacets` and `disjunctiveFacetsRefinements`.

---

_`getConfiguration` will be removed later to not break everything._
